title: Show, Support, Stretch, Spring
format: 11v7 shape game on a big pitch
area: 70m x 46m, a goal at each end
kit: Blue bibs for our 3-5-2, Red for the opponents, cones on halfway
start: Our keeper (1) starts with the ball
intro_vo: Show, support, stretch, spring. This is how our three five two gets ready to get the ball, and then plays forward.

steps.say: SHOW: 4 drops to show for the ball from 1.
steps.vo: Show! Number four steps away from his marker and shows for the ball, so the keeper has an easy pass.

steps.say: SUPPORT: 8 and 5 give angles. STRETCH: 2 and 3 go wide and high.
steps.vo: Support and stretch. Eight and five give short angles, and the wing backs, two and three, stay really wide and high. Now the pitch is big.

steps.say: 4 opens his body and plays forward to 7.
steps.vo: Four opens his body so he can see forward, and plays the first pass forward into seven.
Spring! As soon as the ball goes forward, nine and eleven spin away and three bombs on down the side.
Three crosses early, and nine attacks the near post. Goal!
Show, support, stretch, spring. Get ready before the ball arrives.

setup: Our eleven in a 3-5-2 against six outfield players and a keeper.
rules: Restart from our keeper each time.
A goal from a forward pass in the first three passes counts double.
restart: Ball out: back to our keeper.
points: Show early, before the ball is played.
Open your body to face forward.
progress: Limit our centre backs to two touches.
parents: Watch how the players move before the ball arrives: someone shows short, others give width, and the first pass goes forward.
